annotations.title: Count the files of documents to download

description: Count every file (report PDFs, appendix and data ZIPs, OCR'd copies) of a set of documents before packaging them for download. Give `documents` [{corpus, key}] from any corpus, or `anumbers` for WAMEX reports, or a GeoThought `project_id`; up to 5,000 documents. Or give an `area` (a polygon, or a point and radius) for everything the platform holds there: every document whose extent meets it plus every data layer (drillholes, geochemistry, tenements, geology, ...) as CSV/GeoJSON. Returns the estimate's id, the number of files, the size (and the size of the PDFs alone), which documents have no files on the mirror, how many ZIP parts of about 10 GB it makes, and whether it needs staff approval (over 200 GB). Nothing is built until prepare_download; tell the user the size first. Counting a few thousand documents can take a minute: if `state` is still `estimating`, call download_status with the id.

area.description: {polygon: [[lon, lat], ...]} or {point: [lon, lat], radius_km} (at most 50 km); at most 25,000 km².

documents.description: Documents as {corpus, key}, e.g. {corpus: "wamex", key: "A12345"} or {corpus: "sarig", key: "env01234"}: the corpus and key a search or document tool returned.

name.description: What to call the package (the ZIP and email use it).

project_id.description: A GeoThought project the user can see.
